metadata.title: Speedbird Offshore Sailing Club — Sail Further. Explore More. Belong.
metadata.description: RYA recognised offshore sailing club based on the River Hamble, sailing the Solent and beyond. Join 300+ members with two dedicated offshore yachts.

hero.heading:
Sail Further.
Explore More.
Belong.
hero.backgroundAlt: Aerial view of yachts moored on the River Hamble

sections.heading: Discover the solent, South Coast and beyond
sections.body: From Day Skipper to Coastal Skipper, our RYA practical courses take place on board our own club yachts — based on the River Hamble, sailing the Solent and beyond.

sections.heading:
Two dedicated
offshore yachts
sections.body: Two modern offshore yachts, meticulously maintained and fully equipped for racing, cruising, and training. Our fleet is maintained to the highest standard for offshore cruising — from Channel crossings to Biscay passages. Both yachts fully equipped and RYA compliant.

sections.heading: Experienced offshore sailors. Year-round
sections.body: From seasoned skippers to keen novices — our members share a love of the sea and the camaraderie of offshore sailing.

sections.heading:
Learn sailing on
the water.
sections.body: From Competent Crew, Day Skipper to Coastal Skipper, our RYA practical courses take place on board our own club yachts — based on the River Hamble, sailing the Solent and beyond.

sections.heading: Thinking of joining?
sections.body: From Day Skipper to Coastal Skipper, our RYA practical courses take place on board our own club yachts — based on the River Hamble, sailing the Solent and beyond.

cta.heading: Thinking of joining
cta.body: Whether you’re new to sailing or an experienced sailor, there’s a place for you at our club. Join us to get out on the water, build your skills, enjoy new adventures and become part of a welcoming sailing community.
